findings.desc: Concept blocker: CHK-003 promises Tier-C provider-execution receipt verification stories are grouped as experiment-batch-exception and preserved as evidence, but live lattice queue_governance_status --format=json at 2026-06-30T10:24:09Z reports experimentBatches=[] and summary.experimentBatchException=0 while 22 Tier-C provider-execution receipt verification stories are classified as duplicate-candidate with cleanupPolicy=review-required. That shrinks the promised exception policy and makes queue governance treat preserved experiment evidence as ordinary duplicates.

Fresh final validation evidence is missing at the current review head. review_run_start bound lattice-review-test-coverage B-cd3a:RR-003 to head ec296d3, while CHK-007 records done_required_validate/root-test evidence at head 94d19085554ee72b8f2698c1e186f9adf15e2578 and lattice session_brief reports 19 stale verification intents after ec296d3. Because B-cd3a explicitly relies on done-required validation, root tests, and current-head proof admissibility for final delivery, test coverage should not pass until stale verification evidence and DONE-required validation are refreshed for the current HEAD/material hash.
